Attached: 1 image

Coding agents read instruction files automatically: https://AGENTS.md, https://CLAUDE.md, hooks. That is the point, and the attack surface. A planted line runs before a human sees it.

After 3 injection campaigns in a week, we added a read-only IoC scan to our daily security job. 10 of 10 synthetic plants caught, 2.6% false positives across 43 repos.

https://workloft.ai/ships/poisoned-agent-config-scan-2026-10-31.html
